specs.Set Name: Lenovo Yoga Tab Plus Productivity Bundle (3 Piece)
specs.Configuration: 12.7" 3K Display, Snapdragon 8 Gen 3, 16GB RAM, 512GB, 6-Speaker, 10200 mAh Battery, Pen + Keyboard
specs.Other Special Features of the Product: Fast Charging, Stereo Speakers, Stylus Support

features: Think It. Create It. Share It: From brainstorming concepts and sketching wireframes to editing videos and composing music, the Lenovo Yoga Tab Plus is engineered to fuel every stage of the creative process — its AI-powered features accelerate your workflow, the included Keyboard makes writing and ideation effortless, and the immersive 6-speaker audio system inspires creativity with rich, room-filling sound at every step.

Bigger, Brighter, and Built for Creativity – Experience stunning detail on the expansive 12.7-inch 3K PureSight Pro display with a sharp 2944 × 1840 resolution. Enjoy ultra-smooth visuals with a 144Hz refresh rate, up to 900 nits peak brightness, and vibrant 100% DCI-P3 color accuracy for designing, editing, and content creation. The anti-reflection coating and TÜV-certified High Visibility technology ensure comfortable viewing during long creative sessions, whether you're sketching, editing videos, or multitasking

Powerful Performance for Creative Workflows – Powered by the Qualcomm Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 Mobile Platform, this tablet combines ultra-fast X4, A720, and A520 cores running up to 3.3 GHz for seamless multitasking, editing, and creative productivity. With up to 20 TOPS AI performance, it accelerates AI-assisted workflows, enhances responsiveness, and handles demanding creative applications effortlessly while maintaining impressive power efficiency.

Fast, Smooth, and Built for Creativity – Experience ultra-responsive performance with 16GB LPDDR5x memory paired with lightning-fast 512GB UFS 4.0 storage for seamless multitasking, faster app launches, and efficient creative workflows. Whether you're editing high-resolution content, managing large files, or switching between demanding applications, this setup delivers the speed, reliability, and smooth responsiveness needed for professional creativity and productivity.

Immersive Sound and Precision Cameras for Creators – Experience rich, cinematic audio with a premium 6-speaker system featuring 2 Solo tweeters and 4 SLS sub-woofers, expertly tuned by Harman/Kardon and enhanced with Dolby Atmos. Whether you're editing videos, streaming content, or enjoying music, every detail sounds deeper and more immersive. Capture sharp photos, detailed videos, and crystal-clear video calls with the 13MP front camera and dual rear camera setup (13MP + 2MP with flashlight), designed to support creative workflows and collaboration effortlessly.

Long-Lasting Power for Creativity and Productivity – The integrated 10,200mAh battery is built to keep up with extended creative sessions, multitasking, and entertainment, delivering up to 11 hours of YouTube streaming on a single charge. With support for 45W Quick Charge, you can power up quickly and get back to designing, editing, streaming, and creating without long interruptions.
